children: Sterling could weaken in the lead-up to the budget on October 28 due to renewed political concerns, Ebury's Matthew Ryan says in a note. The government's ambitious spending plans could mean an increase in tax rates and higher debt issuance, measures which could raise U.K. political risk, Ryan says. "The political risk now seems to be grossly underappreciated ahead of the autumn budget," he says. Sterling last trades steady at $1.3525. The euro is also flat at 0.8589 pounds. (miriam.mukuru@wsj.com)
